|quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Lightning Arrow''' is a [[Bows|bow]] [[attack]] [[skill]] that fires an arrow which causes enemies to be struck with a bolt of [[lightning]]. The lightning bolt can hit nearby enemies. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''Hits Additional Targets''': When an arrow strikes a target, up to 3 randomly chosen enemies (up to 5 with 20% gem quality) within an area around that target will also be struck for the same amount of damage. The area within which Lightning Arrow can hit additional targets has a base radius of 18 and is affected by [[area of effect]] modifiers. However, this damage is not affected by modifiers to [[area damage]]. * '''[[Damage conversion]]''': Like all [[Damage conversion|converted damage]], the lightning portion of Lightning Arrow's converted physical damage will be modified by both [[lightning damage]] and [[physical damage]] increases. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Shock
